summary:
ASTRA HEALTH is a Python-based astronaut health-monitoring prototype designed to support the tracking and assessment of astronaut well-being during space missions. It allows users to enter key health indicators, including heart rate, blood oxygen saturation (SpO2), stress, and fatigue levels. The system processes these readings and displays them through an interactive dashboard, making health information easier to understand.

By bringing multiple health indicators together, ASTRA HEALTH demonstrates how software can help organize astronaut health data and highlight potentially unusual readings. This is important because astronauts operate in isolated environments where monitoring health and identifying possible concerns can be challenging.

Developed using Python, Streamlit, Pandas, and NumPy, ASTRA HEALTH aims to demonstrate a practical software-based approach to supporting astronaut health during future space exploration.
details:
ASTRA HEALTH is an astronaut health-monitoring system designed to help track and assess the health of astronauts during space missions. It allows users to enter health parameters such as heart rate, SpO2, stress level, and fatigue level. The system processes these readings, evaluates them against predefined ranges, and presents the results through an interactive dashboard.

The project aims to make astronaut health monitoring easier by organizing important health indicators in one place. It can help identify unusual readings and make health information easier to understand, potentially supporting better health-related decisions during missions.

We developed ASTRA HEALTH using Python, Streamlit, Pandas, and NumPy. The application includes a dashboard, manual data entry, health-data processing, and automated report generation in Markdown format. No dedicated medical hardware was used in this prototype.

Our creative approach was to combine multiple health indicators into a single monitoring interface rather than treating each measurement separately. We considered usability, data validation, readability, and the limitations of monitoring human health in isolated space environments.

ASTRA HEALTH is a prototype demonstrating how software-based health monitoring could contribute to astronaut well-being during future space exploration missions.
